messages:
Nina: Tiny update — terrarium trio encountered a mirror for the first time. chaos and curiosity. photo drop: https://slack-files.com/T0XYZ-PHOTO1-abc123
Sam: hahahaha the one in the back doing the head-tilt :rofl: :eyes:
Devin: wait are those pygmy chameleons? they look like plushies :heart_eyes:
Jules: they met their doppelgangers. this is peak micro-drama. also ambient moss scent?:nose:
Nina: not chameleons — baby anoles + one dwarf gecko. they staged a tiny soap opera in the fern corner
Sam: please tell me there's footage — slow-mo victory stare
Nina: only a 12s clip, uploaded: https://slack-files.com/T0XYZ-VID1-def456
ops-bot: file uploaded by Nina (image, 3.2 MB)
Devin: that clip is cinematic. someone add it to the 'office pets hall of fame' thread :trophy:
Jules: poll: who is winning the mirror duel? 1) Back Anole 2) Front Gecko 3) Moss (underdog)
Sam: 2
Devin: 1
Nina: 3 (always backing the moss)
Sam: also — anyone got tips for a tiny bridge (they keep escaping to the pebble zone)
Jules: try a low cork ramp glued with non-toxic aquarium sealant, works for our snail tank
Nina: bookmarking, thank you! :sparkles:
Devin: @Nina if you want I can make a 3D print file for a micro-bridge
Nina: omg yes please that would be amazing :raised_hands:
Sam: group awww :heart:
Jules: future action item: 'Nina terrarium sequel' for next week
Nina: sequel incoming — possibly with tiny hats
Sam: tiny hats please
